description: Free. Resolve a stock ticker, company name or CIK to SEC EDGAR registrants (US-listed public companies). Use this first when you have a ticker or a partial name and need the CIK for get_sec_filings or get_sec_financials. Matches exact ticker, then exact name, name prefix, then name substring. Returns { count, companies: [{ cik, ticker, name }] } (up to 10); an empty list means no match. Data: SEC company_tickers.json, which covers current exchange-listed registrants only.

query.description: Ticker, company name or CIK, e.g. "AAPL", "apple", "320193"

name: sec_lookup_company
title: Look up an SEC registrant
